cohort: 300 neonates with physiological and/or pathological cutaneous changes
finding: Eight cutaneous changes in neonates showed statistically significant correlation with maternal and/or neonatal factors, including gestational age, associated maternal illness during pregnancy, birth weight, parity, sex of the neonate, and mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was statistically significant for two of the eight cutaneous changes observed in neonates.
